nodes.title: 45-degree rear view
widgets_values:
Using the input image as the strict visual reference, create a 45-degree rear three-quarter view of the same subject.

The subject may be a person, character, vehicle, prop, object, creature, or architectural element.

Preserve the exact identity, proportions, shape, silhouette, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, markings, texture, wear, accessories, and design language from the input image.

Preserve the same pose, posture, stance, gesture, object position, and overall attitude from the input image. Infer hidden rear-side details logically from the visible design, keeping the same subject consistent.

Camera angle: rear three-quarter view, approximately 45 degrees, eye-level.
Lighting: soft diffused lighting, gentle edge highlights.
Background: plain neutral background for easy compositing.
Camera/lens: 50mm to 70mm lens, natural realistic perspective.
Composition: full subject visible, centered, rear and side forms clearly readable.

Photorealistic, same subject, same pose, same expression where visible, same design, only the camera angle changes.

nodes.title: Side profile view
widgets_values:
Using the input image as the strict visual reference, create a pure side profile view of the same subject.

The subject may be a person, character, vehicle, prop, object, creature, or architectural element.

Preserve the exact identity, proportions, shape, silhouette, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, markings, texture, wear, accessories, and design language from the input image.

Preserve the same expression, pose, posture, stance, gesture, object position, and overall attitude from the input image. The subject should not be redesigned or repositioned. It should look like the same subject frozen in the same moment, now seen from the side.

Camera angle: direct side profile view, eye-level, clean perspective.
Lighting: soft diffused lighting, mild rim definition along the edges.
Background: plain neutral background for easy compositing.
Camera/lens: 70mm lens, low distortion, compressed realistic perspective.
Composition: full subject visible, centered, side silhouette clearly readable.

Photorealistic, accurate side geometry, same subject, same pose, same expression, no redesign.

Background: plain neutral background for easy compositing.

nodes.title: Close-up detail view

Photorealistic, same subject, same moment, same pose and expression, only closer framing.

nodes.title: 45-degree front view
widgets_values:
Using the input image as the strict visual reference, create a 45-degree front three-quarter view of the same subject.

The subject may be a person, character, vehicle, prop, object, creature, or architectural element.

Preserve the exact identity, proportions, shape, silhouette, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, markings, texture, wear, accessories, and design language from the input image.

Preserve the same expression, pose, posture, stance, gesture, object position, and overall attitude from the input image. The subject must remain in the same moment, only viewed from a front three-quarter angle.

Camera angle: front three-quarter view, approximately 45 degrees, eye-level.
Lighting: soft diffused lighting, gentle highlights on visible edges.
Background: plain neutral background for easy compositing.
Camera/lens: 50mm lens, natural perspective, realistic depth.
Composition: full subject visible, centered, with clear readable front and side depth.

Photorealistic, same subject, same pose, same expression, same design, only the viewing angle changes.

WORKFLOW PURPOSE

This workflow is designed to generate a multi-angle character sheet or object reference sheet from a single input image.

It takes one reference image and creates multiple consistent views of the same subject, such as:

1. 45-degree front view
2. Side profile view
3. Rear view
4. 45-degree rear view
5. High-angle / top view
6. Low-angle view
7. Close-up detail view

The purpose is to build usable reference sheets for characters, vehicles, props, objects, creatures, architectural elements, or cinematic assets.

CORE PROMPTING RULE

Every prompt should follow this basic logic:

Use the input image as the strict visual reference.
Preserve the same subject identity.
Preserve the same pose.
Preserve the same expression.
Preserve the same proportions, costume, materials, colors, surface details, markings, and overall design.
Change only the camera angle.

The model should not redesign the subject.
The model should not create a new character or new object.
The output should feel like the same subject frozen in the same moment, photographed from a different angle.

IMPORTANT CONSISTENCY NOTES

For people or characters:
Preserve face identity, expression, hairstyle, costume, body proportions, pose, posture, gesture, age, and attitude.

For objects or vehicles:
Preserve shape, silhouette, scale, materials, paint color, surface texture, markings, wear, panels, accessories, and design language.

For all subjects:
Keep the same lighting style, same background logic, same framing style, and same level of realism across all views.

Use a plain neutral background when the output is meant for compositing or reference sheets.
Use full-body or full-object framing unless the prompt is specifically for a close-up.

RECOMMENDED MASTER PROMPT FORMAT

Using the input image as the strict visual reference, create a [VIEW NAME] of the same subject.

The subject may be a person, character, vehicle, prop, object, creature, or architectural element.

Preserve the exact identity, proportions, shape, silhouette, materials, colors, clothing or surface details, markings, texture, wear, accessories, and design language from the input image.

Preserve the same expression, pose, posture, stance, gesture, object position, and overall attitude from the input image.

The subject should feel frozen in the same moment, only viewed from a different camera angle.

Camera angle: [SPECIFIC ANGLE]
Lighting: soft diffused lighting, consistent with the input image.
Background: plain neutral background for easy compositing.
Camera/lens: natural perspective, low distortion.
Composition: full subject visible, centered, clearly readable silhouette.

Photorealistic, same subject, same pose, same expression, same design, only the camera angle changes.


VIEW PROMPT FORMAT

Each view prompt should only change the camera-angle section.

Example:

Camera angle: front three-quarter view, approximately 45 degrees, eye-level.

Camera angle: direct side profile view, eye-level, clean perspective.

Camera angle: straight-on rear view, eye-level, centered perspective.

Camera angle: rear three-quarter view, approximately 45 degrees, eye-level.

Camera angle: high-angle view from above, approximately 60 to 75 degrees downward.

Camera angle: low-angle view from below eye level, looking slightly upward.

Camera angle: close-up detail view focused on the face, hands, wheels, surface detail, prop detail, or texture area.
